render: stage6: tools/stage6/loop_music.py (ElevenLabs Music v2.5 take cut into a loop); boss6: tools/stage6/compose_stage6.py (tools/music/compose.py). Loops checked with tools/music/check_loops.py
note: Loop points match MUSIC.stage6 / MUSIC.boss6 in src/stage6.js (set there, not in src/audio.js, so the pre-fight gate does not grow).

stage6.title: The Stone of Tear
stage6.doc: Stage 6 fortress infiltration. Martial snare and taiko ostinato, low staccato strings, brass stabs and a tolling harbor bell. Tense and driving, steady from the first bar to the last.

source.prompt: Tense, driving orchestral video game stealth-action loop at a steady 120 BPM in D minor. Martial snare and taiko drums in a relentless ostinato, low staccato strings, short brass stabs, and a tolling harbor bell motif every few bars. Constant energy from start to end with no intro, no fade-in, no ending and no fade-out, so it loops seamlessly. Instrumental, no vocals, crisp modern cinematic production.

boss6.doc: "The Netweaver" - Stage 6 boss duel with Be'lal. C minor. Dark choir, low string ostinato, war drums, taiko-style toms, timpani and heavy brass. 40 bars @ 132 bpm.
boss6.title: The Netweaver

source.why: the ElevenLabs boss take failed with "Insufficient funds" (workspace out of credits), so boss6 uses the Stage 1-5 composer
